$Comment: The feast stall. Season makes the stall, and every offer naming it, absent while the feast is off.
Order 90 keeps it behind a server's everyday storefronts, so a shop block or a conversation line that
opens the first storefront never lands here. Where keeps the stall in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere
else it is left out of every list and opens closed.
Everything here is priced in festival tokens, the currency every season shares. Includes carries the
festival shelf (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Festival_Stall) beside the host's own goods: the same offers every
season's host sells, with one purchase limit across them all. The shelf brings its own wallet, place
and name, so the header shows festival tokens and the festival shelf follows the host's own shelves
with no line of its own here. CategoryOrder fixes the order of the host's own shelves, and each one's
name is a key in harvestfeast.progression.lang.
